scope: Artifact prerequisite, not full DJI accounting/provider export

architecture.download_is_command: It writes a safe access ledger before returning bytes

artifact.source: Finalized pay run with finalized_at; amounts from persisted payslips and employee codes at export creation
artifact.legacy_units: Preserves existing integer display contract of *_cents columns; no division by 100 or source data conversion
artifact.encoding: UTF-8 BOM, CRLF CSV, formula-safe employee cells
artifact.immutable: Readonly Active Record snapshot/access entries, SQL privileges remain separate
artifact.identity: One persisted v1 per company/pay run; duplicate request returns same record; API 201 new / 200 existing

authorization: realtime requires realtime.read AND both payroll/export read grants
menu/Board conjunctive rule; old any-grant entries preserved
malformed realtime permission arrays fail closed

access_log.meaning: Server prepared an authorized response, not proof browser saved the file
access_log.denied_or_foreign_source: blocked before artifact access; no foreign-source access row

docker.packaging: Existing dependency image plus current source; bundle check passed
docker.csv_dependency: Direct Payroll dependency added; csv 3.3.2 was already installed by Organization; lock metadata resolved locally
docker.web_container_preserved: Explicit docker kill --signal=USR2 xinviec-hrm-web-1; no service-wide signal

limitations: No linked outbound source bridge or automatic artifact transfer
No immutable historical employee-code snapshot at payroll finalization
No retention/redaction/legal hold, remote receipt reconciliation or production quota tuning
Readonly/checksum are not tamper-proof against privileged SQL/key compromise
approval_note: Earlier attempt was not executed because approval-review quota was unavailable; after its reset the authorized writes/migration completed through the normal escalation flow.
